decisions.reason: As a 2023 line extension with several models that remained on the website in 2024, it fits the firm's broad laser portfolio and single-source offering, so withdrawal is possible but not likely.
The thermal inkjet printer stayed on its own product page across 2023 and 2024 and closely matches the firm's core coding applications, which argues for continued support.
The piezo inkjet printer also kept its own page in both years and strengthens the firm's technology-matching strategy for different substrates, making retention the more likely choice.
This 2024 laser marking line was highlighted on the home page as a flagship direction and is highly aligned with the firm's Industry 4.0 and traceability push, so it is very unlikely to be dropped.
The compact laser marking cabin was explicitly launched as new in 2024 and supports the firm's established laser offering, so management would usually give it more time in the market.

Although more specialized, the lubricant printing system builds on the firm's industrial marking expertise and its trade-fair award is a strong positive signal, reducing the chance of near-term withdrawal.
